critical_code_review_comments: BrokerBindingRequestPage uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML for broker-supplied custom_terms_html. The risk is acceptable here because brokers are admin-vetted before custom_terms become active, but recommend sanitizing the HTML server-side (DOMPurify-equivalent) on the PATCH /brokers/custom-terms endpoint to defense-in-depth against a compromised broker account injecting XSS payloads that would execute in every buyer's browser visiting that broker's binding page.

BrokerDashboardPage loadAnalytics swallows errors silently; suggest surfacing a small inline 'unable to refresh KPIs' badge so a buyer-facing broker notices stale numbers if the 60s poll repeatedly fails.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bugs: (#1) frontend hardcoded an extra '/api' segment on top of API_BASE (which already ended in /api), producing double-prefix 404s — fixed by aligning with the rest of the codebase pattern of API_BASE + '/broker-relationships/...'. (#2) UX bug where custom contract was hidden behind a modal click — fixed by inlining the HTML/text in a scrollable card above the deposit button. (#3) Broker dashboard read stale snapshot counters from the broker document — replaced with on-demand /brokers/me/analytics aggregation pipeline over broker_buyer_relationships + broker_bids + broker_invoices. (#4) Admin broker management omitted the document URLs that were already in the DB — added BrokerDocuments component rendering license/registration/extra links plus provincial license badges. All 4 root causes resolved; tests confirm no regression.
